Only two references: Bombay 2010 (overview) and Ethnologue 2025; zero descriptive references. Alternative names Bernde, Tar Murba; AES vigorous.

sources.citation: Bombay, Elaine. 2010. Enquête sociolinguistique sur les parlers Bayo, Morbo, Morom, and Bolong du Tchad: rapport. SIL Electronic Survey Report 2010-019. Dallas: SIL International. 38 pp.
sources.note: Nothing. Sociolinguistic survey (Dec 2002 team, Guéra): sections 1-6 cover geography, language situation, methods, wordlist similarity, intelligibility, attitudes. Annexe D (pp. 29-36) gives 160-item wordlists for Kenga, Naba, Morbo, Bolongue, Bayo, Morom in broad IPA with no tone or stress marks. The word 'accent' appears only in the group questionnaire (Annexe A) in the sense of regional accent. Reference list names 'Dakouli, Padeu et al. 1997. A Partial Investigation of the Morom Language of the Guera, Chad. Unpublished manuscript.'

sources.note: No phonology content. Administrative form: rationale for renaming Bernde to Morom (village on the trans-Chadian highway, founded 12th-13th c., three groups of 1500-2000 each); sources = SIL sociolinguistic surveys of 1998 and 2002; no published sources cited; no wordlist.
Stub; cites Ethnologue 18th ed. only; no phonology.
